title: Compute Node Degrees
description: Calculate the degree (number of connections) for both source and target nodes. For directed graphs, specify whether to use in-degree, out-degree, or both.

title: Multiply Degrees
description: Multiply the degrees of the two nodes together. The product represents the likelihood of a connection forming between them.

title: Apply Normalization (Optional)
description: If desired, normalize the score by dividing by the sum of degree products for all node pairs, or by the square of total edges, to get a probability-like value.
